Placing it at the front of Zone C makes it a "volatile bit" that sits ahead of your stable event stream, silently converting every 0.1× cache read into a full 1.25× re-write each turn (the exact mechanism measured in FM-7). By pinning it to the end, callers automatically land it in the deliberately uncached tail, preserving cache hits on the immutable events behind the breakpoint.
